recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, symmetrical headshot of a man with dark wavy hair against a flat, saturated red background, featuring layered geometric typography with drop shadows and a neon-like scribbled halo element.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's eyes serve as the central focal point, aligned with the horizontal axis.
The typography is layered over the subject's hair, creating a sense of depth.
The vibrant red background contrasts sharply with the cool blue of the subject's collar.
A thin, magenta scribbled line connects the two main lines of text.
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused studio lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up headshot, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's direct gaze and the bridge of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves upward to the blocky display text, then follows the magenta scribble down to the secondary title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid red space surrounding the head, providing high contrast for the dark hair.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan Blue and Yellow (Typography and Collar)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and accents, with naturalistic skin tones and high-value highlights on the face.

letterConstructionRules: Upper text consists of individual letters placed inside cyan squares with yellow drop shadows.
Lower text uses a high-contrast serif with elongated, stylized initials.
A hand-drawn magenta line loops around the upper text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters of the subtitle are significantly larger and feature a yellow fill with black outlines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric block sans-serif paired with a delicate, high-contrast serif for a 'modern meets classic' 80s look.

preserve: Wide tracking of the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 80s sans-serif feel for the main name.
Provides the high-contrast serif look needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution studio portrait of a man with 80s-style wavy dark hair, looking directly at the camera, wearing a light blue collared shirt, set against a solid, vibrant red background. Lighting should be soft and even across the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in a wide-tracked geometric sans-serif, each letter inside a cyan square with a yellow drop shadow. Add a magenta scribbled line looping around the text. Below, add the subtitle in a white high-contrast serif, with the first letter of each word enlarged and styled with a yellow fill.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated red?
Are the top letters enclosed in cyan squares?
Is there a magenta scribble element?
Is the portrait centered and symmetrical?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on graphic elements
Smooth skin retouching typical of 80s airbrushing
High color contrast between red and cyan

postGenerationChecks: Check for proper alignment of the cyan squares.
Ensure the yellow drop shadows are consistent in direction.
Verify the magenta scribble does not obscure the eyes.
Confirm the red background is uniform without gradients.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Portrait + Saturated Red Background + Block-in-Square Typography + Neon Scribble Accent
